name: Exide Industries Ltd
_note: Standalone basis unless marked. Rupee figures in crore. Every number carries its source; nothing after 30-Sep-2026 is used.

profile.what: India's largest lead-acid battery maker: automotive batteries for OEMs and the replacement market (2W, 3W, 4W, e-rickshaw), home inverter/UPS and solar batteries, and industrial batteries (railways, traction, power, telecom, data centres, industrial UPS, submarines); exports to 70+ countries.
profile.plants: 16 plants: 11 Exide lead-acid plants, 3 lead-recycling plants of Chloride Metals (100% subsidiary), 2 plants of Exide Energy Solutions (lithium-ion cells in Bengaluru; packs and modules at Prantij, Gujarat).
profile.network: 120,000+ network touchpoints, ~60 warehouses, 18,000+ villages, 1,600+ Exide Care outlets; 75+ OEM customers.
profile.mix: Auto (OEM + replacement) ~50-53% of revenue, non-auto ~47-50% (Q4FY26 call); B2C (replacement/trade) ~65-70% (AR FY26); institutional sales Rs4,241 cr vs non-institutional Rs13,000 cr in FY26 (AR FY26 note 25); exports Rs915 cr (5.3%); home UPS ~Rs2,300 cr; solar >Rs1,000 cr; telecom ~2-3%.

eesl.capacity: Phase 1: 6 GWh (3 GWh NMC cylindrical for 2W, 3 GWh LFP prismatic for 3W, telecom, stationary, 4W); land and utilities built for 12 GWh; Phase 2 mostly LFP, needs 'much lesser' capex than Phase 1 (Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 calls).
eesl.status: Q1FY27: equipment on all four lines installed, utilities fully operational; first NMC cylindrical cells shipped as customer samples; LFP prismatic samples to 3W and telecom; BIS and UN 38.3 certifications done; revenue expected 'during FY27'; line 4 (4W) to be commissioned by about end-FY27. First-year utilisation 25-30% guided; target 85% utilisation at 90% yield (Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 calls).
eesl.funding: Cumulative equity Rs4,902 cr at 31-Jul-2026 (Rs1,500 cr in FY26); Board approval Rs1,400 cr for FY27 (capex plus opex and working capital), to be funded from operating cash flow. Pack business (imported cells) Rs100-200 cr revenue, not profitable.
eesl.partners: Technology licence from SVOLT (China) for 4-5 products, transferred before Chinese export curbs; raw materials currently imported from China; target 50-60% localisation of the bill of materials in 2-3 years. Non-binding co-investment MoU with Hyundai-Kia for a customised line (not in FY27). Not in the ACC PLI scheme; studying the re-opened 10 GWh PLI tranche.
eesl.src: Q4FY26 call (6-May-2026); Q1FY27 call (3-Aug-2026); Q1FY27 presentation; MOFSL 3-Aug-2026

q1fy27.volumes: 4W replacement volume +10%, 4W OEM +21%, 2W OEM +20%, solar +12-14% (CEO); prices +4-6% YoY; auto OEM +25% for a third quarter; home inverter and solar +20%+; solar revenue >Rs400 cr; industrial ex-telecom double digit; exports +20%+ after five quarters of decline; government tenders muted.
q1fy27.src: Q1FY27 presentation and call; ICICI Securities 4-Aug-2026 (cost lines); Screener standalone (other income, interest, depreciation)

guidance: Core lead-acid: high single digit to early double digit growth; five-year CAGR ~11% +/-1% (Q4FY26 call).
FY27: no revenue guidance; H2 growth lower in percentage terms on the high auto-OEM base (Q1FY27 call).
Capex: ~Rs500 cr a year for lead-acid (Q1FY27 call).
EESL: Rs1,400 cr in FY27; revenue during FY27; 25-30% utilisation in the first year (Q1FY27 call).
history: Board and shareholders approve sale of Exide Life Insurance to HDFC Life
Sale completed: Rs725.98 cr cash + 8.70 cr HDFC Life shares (valued Rs5,652.53 cr); standalone exceptional gain Rs4,694 cr in FY22

First lithium-ion cells (NMC cylindrical samples) from the Bengaluru plant
